title: Lightweight Ranking Heads: Accelerating Multi-Task Experimentation in Production Recommender Systems
abstract: arXiv:2609.25433v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Modern production-scale recommender systems rely on complex, multi-task ranking models. Introducing new prediction tasks into these massive systems often causes bottlenecks - it risks negative task conflicts with existing tasks, and can lead to long development and experimentation cycles due to the expensive retraining of backbone models and downstream models or tuning of reward combination formulas. To address the critical challenge of slow experimentation velocity, we introduce the Lightweight Ranking Heads (Light Heads) framework. Designed for continuous online learning environments, Light Heads enable the dynamic injection of new tasks into existing multi-task ranking models, effectively obviating the need for model cold-starting and retraining of backbone models. translated_title: 轻量级排序头：加速生产级推荐系统中的多任务实验
translated_abstract: 现代生产级规模的推荐系统依赖于复杂的多任务排序模型。向这些庞大的系统中引入新的预测任务往往会造成瓶颈——这可能带来与现有任务的负面冲突，并且由于骨干模型和下游模型的重新训练成本高昂，或需要调整奖励组合公式，导致漫长的开发和实验周期。为解决实验速度缓慢这一关键挑战，我们提出了轻量级排序头框架。该框架专为持续在线学习环境设计，支持将新任务动态注入现有的多任务排序模型中，从而有效免除了模型冷启动和骨干模型重新训练的需要。通过利用停止梯度和无状态的每日训练，该设计严格隔离了新任务，降低了任务间负面冲突的风险。至关重要的是，该框架
tldr: 提出轻量级排序头框架，通过停止梯度和无状态每日训练，将新任务动态注入现有多任务排序模型，无需冷启动或重训骨干模型，同时严格隔离新任务以避免负面任务冲突，从而大幅加速生产级推荐系统的多任务实验。
en_tdlr: The Light Heads framework enables dynamic injection of new tasks into existing multi-task ranking models via stop-gradients and stateless daily training, eliminating cold-starting and backbone retraining while isolating new tasks to prevent negative conflicts, thereby accelerating multi-task experimentation in production recommender systems.
